name: PrimWObject::Prim33 (SimAntics opcode 0x33, ManageInventory)
notes: Hooked (not yet run in-game). No original callees (the cached service getter 0xb390c0, singleton 0x20ddfb and director framework getter 0x1ae18d are ours). Works on the person's inventory (cTSInventory, vtable 0xdcdb70) the selector in param byte +4 (bits 0..2 kind, bit 3 mode) names: kinds 0..3 through the context holder's slot 6 object (slots 36..39), kind 4 the holder's slot 17, else error 0x57; opcode 9 in mode 0 reuses the selector remembered in the object (+0x1b0..+0x1be, cursor at +0x1c0). Token = dword at +9, or (zero, for some operations) the owner id of the stack object's table entry (this slot 63, frame slot 12; error 0x15). Mode 0 (inventory list slots 28/29): 0 slot 16 test, 1 slot 20, 2 slot 18, 3 find (slot 25) store 1-based position, 4 entry slot 20, 5 entry slot 19 value stored, 6 remember entry (cursor slot 29 and +0x1b0 block), 7/8 read/write a word of the cursor list (slots 24/26/22), 9 apply remembered entry (errors 0x9c, 0x9d), 0xa slot 31 stored, 0xb director helper (clsid 0x4aba86f3/0x4aba86dd) takes the cursor, inventory slot 15, 0xc find (slot 24), 0xd slot 30 stored, 0xe entry slot 22, 0xf entry slot 21 stored, 0x10/0x13 create an entry from the stack object and add it (table slots 87/90, helper), 0x11 move an entry out (table slots 88/16/29, frame slot 13), 0x12 transfer to another person (slot 48). Mode 1 (second list, slots 42/43): 0 slot 33, 1 slot 33 with the item's data, 2 slot 34, 3 slot 34 with the item's data, 4 slot 35, 5 slot 36 (error 0x74), 6/7/8/9 find (slots 37/38/39) and store position / remember entry / read two words, 0xa count, 0xb slot 49 on another person. Returns 1 or 0. ORIGINAL-BUG: mode 1 operations 1 and 3 call inventory slots 33/34 (ret 0x10/0x0c) with one argument; the callee reads and pops stack words that are not arguments (the epilogue then even pops a wrong word into esi, which the harness hides by saving esi): ours passes zeros for the missing arguments (untestable: the extra arguments are undefined stack). ORIGINAL-BUG: operations 0x10/0x13 use the director's helper object without a null check. Differential: 80,000 seeds, 23-object recording-fake world (own harness tests/simantics_prims_w.h), exception injection (a fake throws at the Nth call in 1/6 of the seeds), operand reader with per-call answers and independent destination storage, original called through a register-saving trampoline. Mutants (80 tried; three first survived (two unwind releases, the second destination check) and the test was strengthened with deeper exception injection and independent destination storage): 78 killed; the two survivors are equivalent: the sign extension of the remembered selector kind (any 16-bit kind that is not 0..4 gives the same error) and the cached service getter call (cache filled, no observable effect; the getter has its own test). Killed mutants include slot numbers and argument order of every operation, return and error codes, index arithmetic, 16/32-bit widths, mode and selector bits, the unwind releases of the three frame references, AddRef, list getters and operand offsets.
